This Agreement is made and entered into on this 24th day of May, 2025, by and between
John Doe, residing at 123 Main Street, Cityville, State, ZIP Code, hereinafter referred to as
“Party A”, and Jane Smith, residing at 456 Oak Avenue, Townsville, State, ZIP Code,
hereinafter referred to as “Party B”.
1. Purpose
The purpose of this Agreement is to establish the terms and conditions under which both
parties agree to cooperate and fulfill their respective responsibilities as outlined herein.
2. Terms and Conditions
2.1. Both parties agree to act in good faith and in the best interest of a successful
outcome.
2.2. Each party shall fulfill the responsibilities assigned to them in a timely and
professional manner.
2.3. Any changes or amendments to this Agreement must be made in writing and
signed by both parties.
2.4. This Agreement shall remain in effect from the date first written above and shall
continue until terminated by either party with 30 days written notice.
3. Confidentiality
Both parties agree to keep all information shared under this Agreement confidential and
shall not disclose it to any third party without prior written consent.
4. Governing Law
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the
State in which the parties reside.
By signing below, both parties acknowledge that they have read, understood, and agree to
be bound by the terms and conditions of this Agreement.
Party A Party B
